method.name: AccessCheck
method.summary: Determine if an access key grants a protected operation.
method.returns: True if access is granted; otherwise false.

method.name: AccessCheckIndexAsync
method.summary: Determine asynchronously if an access key grants an explicit protected operation index.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous access-check flow.
method.returns: True if access is granted; otherwise false.

method.name: AccessCheckIndex
method.summary: Determine if an access key grants an explicit protected operation index.
method.returns: True if access is granted; otherwise false.

method.name: AccessCheckAsync
method.summary: Determine asynchronously if an access key grants a protected operation.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous access-check flow.
method.returns: True if access is granted; otherwise false.

method.name: Authorize
method.summary: Determine if an access key is currently valid for this tool context without requiring a protected operation.
method.returns: True if the key is valid, not expired, still a current membership, and passes access policy evaluation without an operation; otherwise false.

method.name: AuthorizeAsync
method.summary: Determine asynchronously if an access key is currently valid for this tool context without requiring a protected operation.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous authorization flow.
method.returns: True if the key is valid, not expired, still a current membership, and passes access policy evaluation without an operation; otherwise false.

method.name: DestroySecrets
method.returns: True if memberships and realm-key material are destroyed.

method.name: GenerateAccessKeyAsync
method.summary: Generate asynchronously an AccessKey of the requested type using explicit issuance options.
method.param: Optional issuance settings including subject, operations, lifetime, audiences, and scopes. Null is normalized to default issuance behavior.
Cancellation token for the asynchronous key-generation flow.
method.returns: Generated AccessKey, or null if generation fails or the requested type is unsupported. Null or empty audiences mean no audience restriction, and null or empty scopes mean no additional scope claims.

method.name: GenerateAccessKey
method.summary: Generate an AccessKey of the requested type using explicit issuance options.
method.param: Optional issuance settings including subject, operations, lifetime, audiences, and scopes. Null is normalized to default issuance behavior.
method.returns: Generated AccessKey, or null if generation fails or the requested type is unsupported. Null or empty audiences mean no audience restriction, and null or empty scopes mean no additional scope claims.

method.name: RequestAccessAsync
method.summary: Issue asynchronously a role-specific access key in response to an access request after request normalization and policy evaluation.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous request-access flow.
method.returns: Issued access key, or null if the request cannot be satisfied or request policy denies the request.

method.name: RevokeAccessAsync
method.summary: Revoke asynchronously an access key by removing its current membership if revocation policy allows it.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous revocation flow.
method.returns: True if the membership is revoked; otherwise false.

method.name: QueryMembershipCatalog
method.summary: Query an authoritative rich membership catalog for the current access manager.
method.returns: An authoritative rich membership catalog matching the supplied query filters.

method.name: QuerySnapshot
method.summary: Query a filtered Access Manager snapshot from authoritative locally known membership metadata.
method.returns: A filtered Access Manager snapshot containing the current manifest identity and any resolved active membership entries matching the query.

method.name: RequestAccess
method.summary: Issue a role-specific access key in response to an access request after request normalization and policy evaluation.
method.returns: Issued access key, or null if the request cannot be satisfied or request policy denies the request.

method.name: RevokeAccess
method.summary: Revoke an access key by removing its current membership if revocation policy allows it.
method.returns: True if the membership is revoked; otherwise false.

method.name: UpdateMembershipCatalog
method.summary: Update the current authoritative membership catalog using an explicit rich membership payload and update operation.
method.returns: True if the rich membership-catalog update succeeds; otherwise false.
